## The tentative project title

Is Mamdani's New York a Happier, Healthier New York?

## The motivation for this project

We are interested in seeing how Mamdani's policies have translated into action and how they have impacted the people of New York!!

## The intended final products

We want to show both positive and negative associations between Mamdani's time as Mayor and social and health outcomes for the city's residents.

## The anticipated data sources

311 complaints, various datasets related to housing in New York, MTA subway and bus ridership data, Citibike data, 
data on mental health outcomes and other determinants of overall popoulation happinness (TBD).

## The planned analyses / visualizations / coding challenges

We will be comparing all of these data from before Mamdani came into office with after. For visualization we can look at different boroughs, neighborhood complaints, age distrubutions, and political affiliations. We foresee potential challenges with finding corresponding data that is recent enough and paired. It might also be hard to find and interpret any mental health or happinness data. Since it is difficult to control for confounding variables, our conclusions will have the necessary assumptions and limitations. 

## The planned timeline

Week 1, we will first obtain and process all of the data sets. Week 2, we will do exploratory analysis and visualization of individual variables
Week 3, we will look at associations and compile everything together, start writing the report
Week 4, we will work on all final touches, adding linear regression if suitable and anything else we see fit
